capabilities: Sync the full vault, including attachments, nested folders, and .obsidian, with Google Drive
Pull Drive changes on startup and push local changes on an interval
Run manual pull and push commands with separate directional actions
Authenticate with the user's own Google Cloud OAuth client
Resolve duplicate folders and files, with confirmation before large deletions
extras: Warns that Google expires Drive refresh tokens after 7 days if the OAuth app stays in External + Testing mode; not yet listed in the community plugin directory (manual install documented). Discloses clipboard access, base64 calls, and five external domains; not affiliated with Google or Obsidian.
motivation: Built for people who want vault sync without relying on shared credentials or a shared backend.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service, and this fills the gap with free Google Drive syncing under the user's own Google account and credentials.

relations.evidence: Tether includes the hidden .handwriting folder and its JSON files in vault sync.

requires.name: Google Cloud project with Drive API and OAuth client

summary: Google Drive sync plugin that keeps the whole vault (notes, attachments, folders, .obsidian) in sync using the user's own Google Cloud OAuth credentials.
